description: A powerfully built brown-skinned humanoid with a mass of wild dark blue hair, two curved pale horns rising from its head, green eyes and a wide grin. It is bare-chested, wearing a necklace of white teeth or bones with a small skull at the center, and a skirt of green and blue grass or leaves. In its right hand it holds a short wooden staff topped with a white skull; its left fist is clenched at its side. It is shown from the waist up, facing the viewer at eye level, against a plain black background. The colors are warm browns and bright blues, the mood is fierce and ritual. Frame 1: the staff leans out to the side, skull low. Frame 2: the staff is raised upright with the skull high beside the head. Frame 3: the staff tilts partway back down. The raised pose is held longest and the other two flash briefly, so the loop reads as a slow shake of a ceremonial rattle.
title: Horned savage with skull rattle
